blocks.html:
Every mechanism starts in CAD. In your first weeks you will learn Onshape, model a few simple parts and then help on a real mechanism with a lead.

  1. Create an Onshape education account with your school email.
  2. Complete the Onshape fundamentals course (linked below).
  3. Ask a lead to share the team's current-season documents with you.
  4. Model a simple part from a drawing, then get it reviewed.

blocks.html:
Before a design goes to fabrication, walk through this list with a lead:

  • Does it fit inside frame perimeter and height limits for the current game?
  • Are all parts fully constrained and named clearly?
  • Can every bolt be reached with a tool on the real robot?
  • Is the weight estimate updated in the robot master assembly?
  • Are drawings ready for every part the shop needs to make?
